findings.positivity: TVB limiter controls oscillations but does NOT guarantee pointwise positivity. Quadrature-point rho and p can be negative near discontinuities. A Zhang-Shu positivity limiter would be needed for strict positivity.
findings.mass_conservation: 25% mass change at 16x16 suggests the TVB limiter's modal scaling is not conservative at coarse resolution. This should be investigated at finer meshes.
findings.finite: Solution remains finite throughout, confirming numerical stability of the DG+HLLC+SSP-RK3+TVB pipeline.

notes: Full convergence study deferred due to system load >= 100. Smoke run reveals two honest limitations: (1) TVB does not guarantee pointwise positivity, (2) mass conservation at coarse resolution needs investigation. These are documented as findings, not hidden.
